messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "if you choose a different weekly injection day start new schedule after at least 2 days have passed since last injection"
set: ["if you choose a different weekly injection day start new schedule after at least 2 days have passed since last injection", "patients can start Rybelsus up to 7 days after last injection", "use new needle for each injection", "remove needle after each injection", "once-weekly injection", "at least five days", "start with 0.25 mg subcutaneous injection once weekly for 4 weeks", "report symptoms at injection site", "take at least 2 hours after an antacid", "skip the missed dose if more than 5 days have passed", "do not breastfeed for at least 1 week after last dose", "choose site at least two inches from belly button", "talk to your doctor if you have new pain after taking tramadol", "wait at least 14 days after stopping before starting MAOI", "take other medications at least 2 hours before or after", "skip the missed dose if it has been more than 4 days since your last dose"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
